project_type: TypeScript CLI/TUI/Web-UI orchestrator for coding agents
build_system: Bun + tsup. scripts/build-reducer.ts bundles src/web/reducer.ts into an IIFE (SteamtrainReducer global) for the browser. Must rebuild reducer before tests.
test_framework: Vitest - tests live in tests/ directory with descriptive filenames. Pattern: describe/it blocks, test helpers in harness functions.
build_command: bun run build (runs build-reducer.ts first, then tsup, then copy-assets)
test_command: bun run test (runs build-reducer.ts as pretest, then vitest run)
verification_instructions: 1) bun run lint, 2) bun run typecheck, 3) bun run test, 4) bun run build
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/web/public/steamtrain-reducer.bundle.js is generated by scripts/build-reducer.ts from src/web/reducer.ts. Must be regenerated after modifying reducer exports. Run: bun scripts/build-reducer.ts
environment_constraints: Agent CLIs (claude/opencode/etc) are NOT installed. Bun + Node 20+ available. Full internet access.
contribution_requirements: No comments unless explicitly requested. Biome formatting. Run lint+typecheck+test+build before submitting. Feature branches from main.
key_patterns: 1) NotifyConfig in config/types.ts with zod schema validation. 2) createNotifier() + notifyWorkflowEvent() in workflow/notify.ts - fire-and-forget, best-effort channels. 3) run-deep-link.ts exports parseRunDeepLink(hash) and runDeepLink(runId) - exposed to browser via reducer bundle. 4) Web UI app.js is vanilla JS SPA, uses apiAuth() helper that redirects to showLoginForm() on 401. 5) EventSource cannot handle 401 (silently retries), so openStream() does a pre-flight auth check.
directory_structure: src/workflow/ - engine core (notify, approval, events, reducer). src/web/ - HTTP server + public/ frontend. src/config/ - zod schema + config loading. tests/ - flat test files. scripts/ - build helpers.
